_comment: Template for the Watch monitoring roster. Copy to watch-roster.json and edit.
watch-roster.json is gitignored on purpose: it names paying clients and their
infrastructure, and that belongs in an engagement record, not in a public repo.
Every target listed here must be covered by a signed Rules of Engagement and
Authorization Letter. Adding a host to this file does not create authorization
to scan it — it only schedules a scan that the authorization already permits.

targets.notes: RoE signed 2026-01-15, renews annually. Findings go to security@example.com only.
verify=true is opt-in live credential checking — only enabled where the RoE explicitly permits it.
